dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Hmm... Your power to "purify" the Abyss — I'm curious about how I'd tackle that if I ever faced it in battle. Needless to say, I'd have to adapt my strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Well, there is only one way to find out...

choices.text: Wait, you mean to test it out...

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Eh, maybe not now. If we both used our full strength, I doubt even this adepti contraption could withstand the force of our clash.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Let's save that fight for another time and place. For now, I'd like to discuss another matter with you.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: When faced with the Abyss, most creatures either fall victim to its corruption, or — like me — adapt and learn to wield it for themselves.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: You, of course, possess a very special power. Do you have any plans as to how you'd like to use it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have used this power to help others.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: An unsurprising answer. It proves that you're still committed to justice and compassion.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Many people believe they would help others in a time of crisis, yet when they obtain the power to do so, concern themselves only with personal gain.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: What do you think best explains that? A weak will? Or the all-corrupting nature of power?

choices.text: I think you need a firm and steadfast heart.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Master once said that for humans, all roads lead back to the self.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: But I suppose that's not an absolute — not when there are those like you who are still willing to use their power to help others.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Alright, let's leave the discussion here for now. Deep conversations can guide us and help us see the way, but they shouldn't distract us from our training.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: I'll start my drills now — let me know if you'd like to join.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: Everyone experiences desires that they will not speak aloud.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: When they are too weak to realize these desires, they remain concealed deep within their hearts. But when they are strong, the floodgates will open, and all forms of vice come rushing out.

response.speaker: Skirk
response.text: We cannot expect everyone to stay true to their principles, which is why we constrain ourselves with laws.
